meta.title: Andheri East Coworking Atlas
meta.sub: Competitive analysis: 12 coworking centres visited, read against Autopilot's three proposed buildings
meta.sheet: Visited_Co-working_Space.xlsx, Autopilot site visits, October 2026; Proposed_Inventory.pdf (October 2026). Rustomjee Central Park is left out of the proposed inventory, not of the competitor set. Positions and public facts researched 23 Oct 2026, sources on each row.

speed.note: TomTom Traffic Index 2025, Mumbai rush hour

nextSteps: Price Autopilot's seats against the building each proposed site actually competes with: Smartworks at Fleet House (Rs 23,000) and WeWork at Raheja Platinum (Rs 28,000) for Privilon and 723 Avenue; Quest, 315Work and the two Executive Spaces centres (Rs 14,000 to 18,000) for Corporate Avenue.
Re-visit Quest Coworks and WeWork: together they hold about 500 of the roughly 800 vacant seats counted, so their pricing on the big cabins is the real competition for a 100-plus seat enquiry.
Ask Innov8 and Community Coworks for their list price at Akruti Trade Star in writing: the same building was quoted at Rs 16,500 and Rs 20,000 on the same week.
Confirm parking at Innov8 Trade Star and Awfis Skyline Icon, which the visit sheet left as TBD, before quoting parking in any comparison.
Time the walk from the station each centre names at 6 to 7 pm; the metro distances here are the sources' figures, not measured.

zones.label: WEH
zones.name: Western Express Highway end of Andheri-Kurla Road (WEH and Gundavali metro)
zones.character: Where Line 1 meets Line 7 and the highway. B-grade blocks at the station: the cheapest desks visited and the smallest centres.

zones.label: Chakala and MIDC
zones.name: Chakala and MIDC (Mahakali Caves Road, Cardinal Gracias Road, MIDC Road 7)
zones.character: Campus-style B buildings a short walk from WEH, Chakala or MIDC Andheri stations. Where Corporate Avenue, the only ready proposed floor, sits.

zones.label: J B Nagar
zones.name: J B Nagar (Andheri-Kurla Road at Chakala metro)
zones.character: Mid-corridor on Andheri-Kurla Road, at the Chakala (J B Nagar) station. Trade Star here now has Innov8 and, from 2026, Executive Spaces; Table Space's R Square and HDFC Bank are neighbours.

zones.label: Marol
zones.name: Marol (Marol Naka interchange, Sag Baug Road, Andheri-Kurla Road)
zones.character: The interchange of Lines 1 and 3 and the big national operators: WeWork, Smartworks and Awfis. The dearest seats and the two bare-shell proposed buildings.

zones.label: Vile Parle E
zones.name: Vile Parle East, on the Western Express Highway
zones.character: South of Andheri East on the same highway; one large Innov8 centre competing for WEH tenants.

places.name: Corporate Avenue (Atul Projects)
places.sub: Proposed: 3rd and 4th floors, 12,414 sq ft carpet, furnished
places.note: Grade A, G+8. Rs 300 per sq ft on carpet, CAM included. Fire NOC and OC available; ready immediately. 5 car parks a floor. Chakala metro 800 m. Efficiency 60% assumed because the landlord quoted on carpet. Position: Map place page; Wikimapia's outline for 'Corporate Avenue (Atul Projects)' is 55 m away (https://wikimapia.org/9438559/CORPORATE-AVENUE-Atul-Projects). The PDF says Chakala metro 800 m; myHQ gives WEH and Gundavali 650 m.

places.name: 723 Avenue (Wadhwa)
places.sub: Proposed: 13th and 14th floors, 12,952 sq ft carpet, bare shell
places.note: Grade A, G+15, 11.7 ft ceilings. Rs 316 per sq ft on carpet plus Rs 16 CAM. Fire NOC, OC and CC due November 2026; available November 2026. Parking 1 per 1,000 sq ft built-up. Marol metro 700 m. Position: Plus code 4V5M+VQM printed on the listing, decoded. Marol Co-operative Industrial Estate Road, off Andheri-Kurla Road; the brochure says 1 km from Marol Naka, the PDF 700 m.

places.name: Privilon (Bsafal)
places.sub: Proposed: multiple floors, 15,343 sq ft carpet, bare shell
places.note: Grade A, G+15, 11.7 ft ceilings. Rs 375 per sq ft on carpet plus Rs 30 CAM. Fire NOC, OC and CC due January 2027; available January 2027. Parking to be confirmed. Marol metro 93 m. Position: The place page pin sits within 10 m of the Marol Naka station coordinate, so it marks the address, not a footprint. The developer says 'right next to Marol Metro Station'; the PDF says 93 m.

visit.v: 12 centres by 9 operators across 11 buildings, 11 in Andheri East and 1 in Vile Parle East on the Western Express Highway
visit.note: Includes Executive Spaces at Rustomjee Central Park as a competitor; the building itself is not in the proposed inventory. Visited_Co-working_Space.xlsx (site visits, October 2026).

visit.k: Price per seat, quoted on the visit
visit.v: Rs 14,000 to 28,000 a month plus GST; median Rs 18,000
visit.note: Eight of the 12 sit between Rs 14,000 and 18,000; Executive Spaces at Rustomjee Central Park is the floor at Rs 14,000. The three above Rs 20,000 are WeWork (28,000), Innov8 Zion House (26,000) and Smartworks Fleet House (23,000).

visit.v: About 11,155 seats in total; three centres hold 7,300 of them (WeWork 3,000, Smartworks 2,500, Quest 1,800)

myHQ: dedicated desk and private cabin Rs 12,999 a seat (quoted, negotiable); 60,000 sq ft, about 1,200 seats on two floors (7th-floor page); a second 4th-floor unit of 16,000 sq ft, about 535 seats, managed office at Rs 12,999 on a 12-month lock-in

prices.k: Andheri East asking prices, listing average
prices.v: myHQ states an average of Rs 11,200 a seat a month for Andheri East and a range of Rs 9,999 to 25,000 for a fixed desk
prices.note: Listing asks, marked indicative by the platform. Every visit quote on this atlas is above that average, which is what a cabin seat with a 12-month term costs against a listing's entry price.

operators.v: Listed on NSE and BSE on 10 Oct 2025. At 31 Mar 2026: 76 centres, 8.6 million sq ft, 8 cities, 126,900 desks, occupancy 86.9%; Mumbai 14 centres, 1.5 million sq ft, 19,400 desks. FY26 revenue Rs 2,477 crore, PAT Rs 179 crore
operators.note: Q1 FY27 (Jun 2026): revenue Rs 698 crore, 79 centres, 133,600 desks, occupancy 84.9%, mature centres 87.5%. Embassy Group is the promoter.

operators.v: Listed 17 Jul 2025. FY26 revenue Rs 1,796 crore (+31%), first profitable year (PAT Rs 11 crore); 66 centres, 16.1 million sq ft including LOIs, 231,000 operational seats; mature centres 89% occupied; Mumbai 2.0 million sq ft
operators.note: Added 182,300 sq ft at The Square near T2, Andheri East, in Feb 2026. Enterprise clients are 92% of rental revenue, so Fleet House sells to large teams first.

operators.v: Listed 2024, India's first listed flex operator. FY26 revenue Rs 1,493 crore (+24%), PAT Rs 71 crore; 266 signed centres, about 184,000 seats, 18 cities; Mumbai 36 centres, 24,090 seats
operators.note: Q1 FY27: occupancy 83% at centres over 12 months old, 76% blended; new centres priced 30 to 50% above the portfolio.

operators.v: Part of the OYO group (now PRISM) since 2019. FY26 revenue Rs 201 crore (+76%), PAT Rs 13.7 crore; 58 centres at 31 Mar 2026, 72 by Jul 2026, target 101 in FY27; about 24,000 desks across 1.2 million sq ft (Sep 2025)
operators.note: Lists nine Andheri East centres on its site. Three of the 11 centres on this atlas are Innov8, at three price points: Rs 20,000, 20,000 and 26,000.

operators.v: Founded 2019 in Bengaluru by Manas Mehrotra; about 3 million sq ft and 60,000 seats across 45 locations in five cities (Mar 2025), with a plan to add 2 million sq ft in FY26 for about Rs 400 crore
operators.note: Two addresses in the Mumbai region on its site: Silver Utopia and Wagle Estate, Thane. Positions itself for teams of 25 and above.

operators.v: Mumbai company incorporated 2013 (founder Prasad Shinde). In March 2026 it bought 57,567 sq ft and 51 car parks at Akruti Softech Park, MIDC Marol, from Capgemini for Rs 55.84 crore, to expand in Andheri
operators.note: A second Quest centre is coming to Andheri East, owned rather than leased.

operators.v: Mumbai-only operator, first centre July 2019 (Goregaon East). Its site lists five centres, two of them on this atlas (Rustomjee Central Park and Chandak Chambers); on 31 Mar 2026 it announced a ninth, 650-plus seats at Trade Star, Andheri East, next to Chakala metro
operators.note: That puts Executive Spaces in Trade Star alongside Innov8, with more seats than either Innov8 or Community Coworks reported there.

operators.v: Founded 2019, Mumbai; '1,000+ members, 50+ companies, 50,000+ sq ft'. Two Andheri East centres: Ackruti Trade Centre (MIDC) and Solitaire Corporate Park (Chakala)
Founded 2021, Mumbai (Capt. Ashish Chandna). Centres at Godrej Two (Vikhroli), Mayuresh Square and Boston House; four more announced in Navi Mumbai and Pune
operators.note: Boston House was listed as Inspire Cospaces before the rebrand; some listing sites still use that name.

market.v: One of the three top Grade A submarkets in Q3 2026 with Thane-Belapur Road and Thane; Mumbai gross leasing 3.9 million sq ft in the quarter and a record 14.6 million sq ft in the first nine months of 2026
market.note: Cushman and Wakefield Mumbai MarketBeat, 24 Sep 2026. Mumbai vacancy 8.33%; stock-weighted rent Rs 178.7 per sq ft a month, up 8% in a year.

market.v: Rs 102 to 195 per sq ft a month; up 2% over twelve months and 1% over six
market.note: Knight Frank India, Mumbai H1 2026, 9 Jul 2026. The proposed buildings are quoted at Rs 300 to 375 on carpet, which is Rs 180 to 225 on built-up at the 60% efficiency the landlords assume, inside the top of this band.

market.v: 7.3 million sq ft transacted, the highest half-year ever (+33%); vacancy 15.6%, down 205 basis points; average transacted rent Rs 130 per sq ft a month
market.note: Knight Frank. JP Morgan's 2.2 million sq ft Powai lease was about 31% of the half-year. Flex operators took 0.44 million sq ft of it.

market.v: Vacancy 10.8%, a 16-year low; flex operators 23.8% of the quarter's leasing; stock 163.8 million sq ft; Western Suburbs rents up 1.38% in the quarter
market.note: JLL via Real Estate Asia, 21 Aug 2026.

market.v: MMR occupancy 92.8% in Dec 2025; vacancy to stay low in Andheri East, Goregaon East and BKC with limited new supply in FY2027; Andheri East rents range-bound at 2 to 4% a year
market.note: ICRA, Commercial Real Estate, Office, MMR, February 2026.

market.k: Recent large leases near the centres
market.v: HDFC Bank 2.72 lakh sq ft at R Square, J B Nagar (Rs 6.45 crore a month, Jan 2025); Eternal 84,157 sq ft in Andheri at Rs 160 per sq ft; WeWork 1.26 lakh sq ft at Lightbridge, Saki Vihar, at Rs 109 per sq ft (Nov 2024)

flex.v: 25,820 seats in H1 2026 against 11,226 in H1 2025, up 130%
flex.note: Cushman and Wakefield, 27 Aug 2026. Across India 191,306 seats, GCCs 44% of them; flex about 20% of office leasing by area.

flex.v: 24% of transactions in H1 2026 (11.4 million sq ft), from 21% a year earlier; 2025 was a record 18.6 million sq ft
flex.note: Knight Frank. Colliers puts flex at 23% of Jan to Sep 2026 leasing, up 37% in a year.

flex.k: Flex openings in Andheri East, 2024 to 2026
flex.v: Table Space 1.31 lakh sq ft at R Square (Jan 2024, about 1,500 seats); Innov8 Zion 1 lakh-plus sq ft (Dec 2024); WeWork Lightbridge 1.26 lakh sq ft (lease from Aug 2025); Smartworks The Square 1.82 lakh sq ft (Feb 2026); Quest's 57,567 sq ft purchase at Akruti Softech Park (Mar 2026); Executive Spaces 650-plus seats at Trade Star (announced Mar 2026)

Innov8 Zion: https://therealtytoday.com/news/innov8-launches-its-biggest-ever-flex-space-in-mumbai-at-2-lakh-sq-ft. Roughly 7 lakh sq ft of new flex in the micro-market in two years.

flex.v: WeWork India mature centres 87.5%; Smartworks mature centres 89%; Awfis centres over a year old 83% (blended 76%)

transit.v: Opened end to end on 9 Oct 2025: 33.5 km, 27 stations, Cuffe Parade to Aarey. Weekday average 1.48 lakh riders in Dec 2025; peak day 1.82 lakh
transit.note: Marol Naka had the line's highest footfall, 16.45 lakh entries and exits in Oct to Dec 2025, as the interchange with Line 1. Four of the 11 centres and two of the three proposed buildings are within 700 m of it.

transit.v: Versova to Ghatkopar through Andheri since 8 Jun 2014; about 5 lakh weekday riders, peak 5.47 lakh; 1.11 billion journeys in 11 years
transit.note: Every centre on this atlas is within a kilometre of a Line 1 station: WEH, Chakala, Airport Road, Marol Naka or Saki Naka.

transit.v: Dahisar East to Gundavali, open since 20 Jan 2023; a 58 m bridge links Gundavali to the WEH station on Line 1
transit.note: Brings the western suburbs north of Andheri to the WEH cluster (Boston House, Chandak Chambers, Silver Utopia, Zion House).

transit.v: The 3.4 km Gundavali to T2 link is 71% built; work stopped in early 2025 over a height clash in the airport funnel and resumed in Oct 2026, with March 2028 the earliest opening
transit.note: Until then the airport is reached by Line 3 from Marol Naka (one stop to CSMIA T2).

proposed.v: Standalone building, basement plus ground plus 8 floors, about 2.5 lakh sq ft built-up, about 25,000 sq ft a floor, completed 2014. Occupiers listed: LG Electronics, Petronas Lubricants, Daikin, Vedanta
proposed.note: The PDF offers the 3rd and 4th floors, 12,414 sq ft carpet, furnished, Rs 300 on carpet with CAM included, ready now. The nearest visited competitors are 315Work (Rs 18,000, 500 m), Executive Spaces at Rustomjee Central Park (Rs 14,000, 400 m), Quest (Rs 18,000) and the WEH cluster at Rs 16,000 to 20,000.

proposed.v: MahaRERA P51800050698, registered 28 Apr 2023, proposed completion 31 May 2026 on the filing; 3 basements plus ground plus 14 floors, typical floor about 8,000 sq ft, warm shell; bounded by Raheja Platinum to the east and south
proposed.note: RERA fields read from a mirror; the MahaRERA page itself could not be opened. The PDF puts fire NOC and OC in November 2026. Sale registrations on floors 3, 4 and 7 between Oct 2025 and Mar 2026 (Square Yards). WeWork's 3,000-seat Raheja Platinum is the next building.

proposed.v: 2.5 lakh sq ft, 14 storeys, pre-certified IGBC Platinum, 'right next to Marol metro station', MahaRERA P51800079264 (developer page). Listings: 96 units, 0.78 acres, 11.7 ft ceilings, status 'new launch' or 'under construction', possession January 2030 on ghar.tv
proposed.note: The PDF says approvals and availability in January 2027; the only public completion date found is January 2030. Ask the landlord to reconcile the two before counting on it. Smartworks Fleet House (2,500 seats) is at the same junction.

proposed.k: Proposed rent against the visited market
proposed.v: Rs 300 to 375 per sq ft a month on carpet, CAM included to Rs 30 on top, for 12,414 to 15,343 sq ft carpet each
proposed.note: Proposed_Inventory.pdf; the Rustomjee Central Park floor in the same PDF is not shown, as asked. At the 35 sq ft a seat and 20% margin the Andheri case study uses, Rs 300 on carpet before fit-out is about Rs 13,000 a seat in rent alone; the visited cabins sell at Rs 14,000 to 28,000.
